CustomField.description: The record ID of the Opportunity this gift is mirrored to or was made from by the Opportunity mirror (Connect). Text, not a lookup, so Connect installs where Opportunity does not exist (ADR-0013).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Opportunity this gift is mirrored to, or was made from. Filled in by the Opportunity mirror. Paste an existing Opportunity's record ID to link to it, or clear it to have a new Opportunity made.
CustomField.label: Opportunity ID
